title: Anthropic raises a USD 3.5bn Series E at a USD 61.5bn post-money valuation, led by Lightspeed
summary: Anthropic announced the round on its website.

title: ACM names Andrew Barto and Richard Sutton Turing Award winners; both warn about unsafe AI deployment
summary: The award recognises their work on reinforcement learning.

title: Manus, an autonomous AI agent from Butterfly Effect, launches in invitation-only beta
summary: SiliconANGLE reports the launch drew global attention for the agent's autonomy.

title: Google DeepMind announces Gemini Robotics, a vision-language-action model built on Gemini 2.0
summary: DeepMind describes it as bringing AI into the physical world.

title: OpenAI and CoreWeave agree a deal worth USD 11.9bn over five years, with USD 350m in CoreWeave shares for OpenAI
summary: Wikipedia's OpenAI article dates the deal to March 2025.

title: SCMP reports China's PLA is using the DeepSeek chatbot for non-combat roles
summary: The roles include hospitals, the People's Armed Police and national mobilisation organisations.

title: Alibaba releases QwQ-32B, a reasoning model under Apache 2.0
summary: Wikipedia's Qwen article dates the release to March 2025.

title: US Commerce adds the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence and another Beijing firm to the Entity List, alleging military-related technology
summary: Wikipedia's article on China's AI industry dates the listing to March 2025.

title: Mistral releases Mistral Small 3.1, a smaller and more efficient model with image understanding
summary: Mistral announced the model on its site; Wikipedia lists it as Apache 2.0 licensed.

title: Google releases Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental, a reasoning model
summary: Google says the model reasons before responding and keeps native multimodality.

title: OpenAI enables native image generation in GPT-4o, and Studio Ghibli-style restyling goes viral
summary: CNN reports the feature replaced DALL-E in ChatGPT.

title: Alibaba Cloud releases Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, an open multimodal model under Apache 2.0
summary: The model accepts text, images, video and audio and can output text and audio.

title: xAI acquires X Corp in an all-stock deal valuing X at USD 33bn and xAI at USD 80bn
summary: Reuters reports the two companies were combined into X.AI Holdings Corp.
